summary: Alignment helper: computes a1 + a2 - 1 and subtracts the remainder (a1 + a2 - 1) % a2, rounding the sum up to the next multiple of a2. Callers are allocation sites on UI, playback-buffer and audio-decode paths (UIListComboBoxConstructor, PlaybackBufferAlloc, MediaAudioDecodeDispatch).

operations.description: Compute v = a1 + a2 - 1, the offset expression used to round up to a multiple of a2.
Subtract the remainder v % a2 from v, yielding the highest multiple of a2 that is <= a1 + a2 - 1.

unresolved: Modulo by a2 is undefined when a2 == 0; the raw body has no guard for that case.
Whether a1 is a byte count and a2 an alignment unit is not grounded by this packet; caller argument semantics (UI combo-box, playback buffer, audio decode) are unverified.
